subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement route matrix + security dependencies
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement route matrix + security dependencies

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion on clearance of data residency and throughput needs for the inference workloads. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement and security have a clear path: 

Summary of asks from your team
- Procurement preference: want to understand whether PO (invoice) is possible vs. corporate card; marketplace via Coupa is an option but needs vendor onboarding.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Type II report, executed DPA, and the vendor security questionnaire (we heard an expected 2–3 week review window).

What Redwood can provide today
- Procurement packet attached: pricing summary, sample invoice terms, standard SOW language, and billing contact details.
- We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a DPA draft for your legal to review.
- If marketplace onboarding is faster for you, we can initiate a listing in parallel.

Proposed next actions
1) Can you confirm preferred procurement route (PO / card / Coupa marketplace)?
2) If PO, please share your finance contact and any PO template.
3) We’ll send the SOC 2 redacted report and the DPA draft by EOD tomorrow; Ben will be our internal lead on vendor onboarding items.
4) Optional: schedule a quick 30-minute procurement + security sync next week to triage dependencies. 

Attachments: redwood-procurement-packet.pdf (pricing & billing), vendor_setup_form_clearwater.pdf (optional - your vendor form if you want us to prefill).

Thanks — looking forward to closing the loop.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearWater Procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>, Tom West <tom.west@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement route matrix + security dependencies

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear summary. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement route: for enterprise platform purchases we generally prefer a purchase order (PO) process with net-30 payment terms. We can accept a corporate card for POCs or small pilots but this will likely be a PO for production.
- Marketplace: we do use Coupa but vendor onboarding there takes time and we still require SOC 2 + DPA before approvals. If you can get vendor onboarding started in parallel, that would help shorten lead time.
- Security asks: please share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a DPA draft. We also have a short security questionnaire (attached) that our risk team will send if needed.

What we need from you to move forward:
1) SOC 2 redacted report (PDF)
2) Draft DPA we can share with legal
3) Confirmation you’ll prefill the vendor onboarding form (attached) and an estimate for how long your internal review takes (SOC 2 / DPA turnaround).

If you can send the items above tomorrow that would be ideal — we’ll then route to our risk and procurement teams.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Director, Strategic Partnerships
ClearWater Health
asha.patel@clearwaterhealth.com
(617) 555-0244

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo follow-up: procurement route matrix + security dependencies (internal)

Looping in Priya to coordinate the vendor onboarding and legal pieces. Fast answers to the asks below so we can get ClearWater into the right queue: 

1) SOC 2 evidence
- We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf). Redaction to remove client-identifying details; auditors are fine with that for vendor reviews.

2) DPA / legal
- Priya: attaching our standard DPA draft (DPA-redwood-draft-2027.docx). Recommend we offer a single redline window and ask for ClearWater to track edits.

3) Procurement route guidance
- If ClearWater confirms PO, ops will accept net-30 invoices and we’ll align invoicing contact.
- Marketplace (Coupa) is often faster once onboarding is approved; we can prefill the vendor_setup_form_clearwater.pdf and submit with the SOC2 + DPA to speed things up.

4) Timeline
- We can deliver SOC2 redacted + DPA draft within 24 business hours. Vendor onboarding submission can be completed the same day if procurement provides the procurement vendor URL/form.

Action: Priya — can you confirm the DPA redline cadence and whether legal needs any additional exhibits (data retention, subprocessors list)? I’ll queue the SOC2 redaction with security.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement route matrix + security dependencies

Hi Asha / team —

Thanks — we’ve attached the items you requested and outlined a simple path forward below to avoid blocking procurement: 

What we attached (for your review)
- SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf (redacted Type II report)
- DPA-redwood-draft-2027.docx (editable Word draft)
- redwood-procurement-packet.pdf (pricing, billing contacts, invoicing terms)

Recommended paths (pick one)
A) PO route (preferred by ClearWater) — ClearWater issues PO to Redwood; we invoice net-30. Estimated time: 1–2 weeks after legal signoff. Please send PO template / finance contact.
B) Marketplace (Coupa) — we can submit vendor info + SOC2/DPA now; approvals vary but can shave off ~1 week if procurement has capacity to review onboarding.
C) Card for pilot — quickest for small POC if you want to start usage immediately while PO onboarding proceeds.

Next steps
- Asha / Procurement: confirm which path you want to pursue. If PO, please share finance contact / PO template and we’ll route billing.
- Priya / Ben: we’ll track DPA comments in a shared Doc (suggest Google Drive link) and accept one round of legal redlines.
- I’ll set up a 30-minute sync if helpful — proposed times: Mon 10am PST or Tue 2pm PST; Calendly link: https://calendly.com/irene-redwood/30min

Happy to hop on a call to walk procurement through the SOC2 redactions if that helps.

Best,
Irene Choi

Redwood Inference
